definitions.explanation: Describes the person or thing one loves most. Often used for close family members or romantic partners, conveying deep emotional attachment.

examples.japanese: {最愛|さいあい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}している→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧。
examples.english: I am grateful to my beloved wife.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{最愛|さいあい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: He lost his beloved daughter to illness.

examples.japanese: {最愛|さいあい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ほど⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧なもの⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There is nothing more precious than time spent with the one you love most.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {最愛|さいあい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun. Carries a literary, emotional tone. Common in written language, speeches, and formal contexts. Less common in casual everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最愛|さいあい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (one's most beloved person)
- {最愛|さいあい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧ / ⟦{夫|おっと}→夫：00982_otto⟧ (beloved wife / husband)
- {最愛|さいあい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (beloved child)
- {最愛|さいあい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧ (beloved family)
